title: HONKERS OF THE FROZEN NORTH // THE TRUE THREAT
narrative: Bowen Marsh peeks over the parapet of the Wall through a brass spyglass. In the valley below, it is not an army of blue-eyed wights advancing. It is twelve million giant black-necked Canadian Geese, hissing with their tongues out, pooping on the ice, and aggressively charging anything that breathes. 'Brandon the Builder did not build a seven-hundred-foot wall to stop White Walkers!' Bowen cries in terror. 'He built it because these winged demons will chase you across five counties if you walk near their goslings!'
resolvesPlotHole: The Ancient Evil the Wall Was Actually Built For
introducesPlotHole: The Ancient Evil of Arctic Migratory Waterfowl

options.text: Return the Night King's overdue Citadel library book to placate the geese.
Have Craster's sons form a hockey defense perimeter against the flock.
Resonate Stannis's jaw to sonic frequencies that repel birds.
